author: vrrdnt@users.noreply.github.com
description: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 dedicated server powered by the Plutonium client, running under Wine. Uses iw5mp game mode and config from xerxes-at/IW5ServerConfig (admin/server.cfg + 17 DSR gametype recipes). Requires the user to upload their own legally-owned MW3 game files to /home/container/game/ (free Steam app 42750, English) and to generate an IW5MP server key at https://platform.plutonium.pw/serverkeys. NOTE: the in-browser server hostname comes from the platform server key registration, not the cfg sv_hostname.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plutonium IW5 (Modern Warfare 3) - Pelican install script
# Runs in the installer container; server dir is /mnt/server, mapped to
# /home/container at runtime.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
set -e

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates tar unzip file git

SERVER_DIR="/mnt/server"
PLUTO_DIR="${SERVER_DIR}/plutonium"
GAME_DIR="${SERVER_DIR}/game"
STORAGE_DIR="${PLUTO_DIR}/storage/iw5"
DEFAULTS_DIR="${PLUTO_DIR}/default-configs"
SCRIPTS_DIR="${STORAGE_DIR}/scripts"

mkdir -p "${PLUTO_DIR}" "${GAME_DIR}" "${STORAGE_DIR}" "${DEFAULTS_DIR}" \
    "${SCRIPTS_DIR}/mp" "${GAME_DIR}/admin"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fetch mxve/plutonium-updater.rs (Rust binary that mirrors Plutonium's CDN
# manifest to disk without needing Wine).
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "[install] Locating latest plutonium-updater release..."
UPDATER_URL=$(curl -sL https://api.github.com/repos/mxve/plutonium-updater.rs/releases/latest \
    | grep '"browser_download_url"' \
    | grep -Ei 'linux' \
    | grep -vi 'arm\|aarch\|musl\|sha' \
    | grep -E '\.tar\.gz"' \
    | head -1 \
    | cut -d '"' -f 4)

if [ -z "${UPDATER_URL}" ]; then
    echo "[install] Could not locate plutonium-updater linux asset. Aborting."
    exit 1
fi

echo "[install] Downloading: ${UPDATER_URL}"
curl -sL "${UPDATER_URL}" -o /tmp/updater.tar.gz
mkdir -p /tmp/updater-extract
tar -xzf /tmp/updater.tar.gz -C /tmp/updater-extract

UPDATER_BIN=$(find /tmp/updater-extract -maxdepth 3 -type f -name 'plutonium-updater*' -executable | head -1)
if [ -z "${UPDATER_BIN}" ]; then
    UPDATER_BIN=$(find /tmp/updater-extract -maxdepth 3 -type f -name 'plutonium-updater*' | head -1)
fi
if [ -z "${UPDATER_BIN}" ]; then
    echo "[install] Could not find plutonium-updater binary in extracted archive."
    ls -la /tmp/updater-extract
    exit 1
fi

mv "${UPDATER_BIN}" "${PLUTO_DIR}/plutonium-updater"
chmod +x "${PLUTO_DIR}/plutonium-updater"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pull Plutonium bootstrap files. plutonium-updater v0.4.x has no game arg;
# it mirrors the full CDN manifest (T4+T5+T6+IW5).
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "[install] Fetching Plutonium bootstrap files..."
( cd "${PLUTO_DIR}" && ./plutonium-updater -d . --no-color )

if [ ! -f "${PLUTO_DIR}/bin/plutonium-bootstrapper-win32.exe" ]; then
    echo "[install] plutonium-bootstrapper-win32.exe missing after updater run. Aborting."
    exit 1
fi

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Clone xerxes-at/IW5ServerConfig and stage admin/* as defaults.
#
# IW5 layout differs from T6: there is NO storage/iw5/ tree in the repo. The
# config and DSR recipes live in admin/, which the engine looks for at
# <gamepath>/admin/. The repo is flat:
#   admin/server.cfg        - main cfg (templated, transformed at first boot)
#   admin/default.dspl      - DSPL playlist file
#   admin/*_default.dsr     - 17 DSR gametype recipes (verbatim copy)
#   !start_mp_server.bat    - Windows launch script (ignored)
#   !updatePluto.bat        - Windows updater (ignored)
#
# At runtime we cannot copy admin/* directly to ${GAME_DIR}/admin/ during
# install because GAME_DIR is empty (user hasn't uploaded BO2/MW3 files yet).
# The entrypoint copies on first boot once the user has populated game/.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "[install] Cloning xerxes-at/IW5ServerConfig..."
rm -rf /tmp/iw5cfg
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/xerxes-at/IW5ServerConfig.git /tmp/iw5cfg

if [ ! -d "/tmp/iw5cfg/admin" ]; then
    echo "[install] Unexpected repo layout; /tmp/iw5cfg/admin missing."
    exit 1
fi

echo "[install] Staging admin/ as defaults (will copy to game/admin on first boot)..."
mkdir -p "${DEFAULTS_DIR}/admin"
cp /tmp/iw5cfg/admin/server.cfg     "${DEFAULTS_DIR}/admin/server.cfg.template"
cp /tmp/iw5cfg/admin/default.dspl   "${DEFAULTS_DIR}/admin/default.dspl"
cp /tmp/iw5cfg/admin/*_default.dsr  "${DEFAULTS_DIR}/admin/"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Optional: install Resxt's mapvote script (single-file mod for IW5).
# Goes to storage/iw5/scripts/mapvote.gsc.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [ "${INSTALL_MAPVOTE:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    echo "[install] INSTALL_MAPVOTE=1 -> installing Resxt IW5 mapvote..."
    curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Resxt/Plutonium-IW5-Scripts/main/mapvote/mapvote.gsc" \
        -o "${SCRIPTS_DIR}/mapvote.gsc" \
        || echo "[install] WARN: mapvote.gsc download failed"
else
    echo "[install] INSTALL_MAPVOTE=0 -> skipping mapvote install."
fi

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Optional: install ineedbots/iw5_bot_warfare v2.3.0.
# The release is a zip containing z_svr_bots.iwd which goes to storage/iw5/.
# Plutonium auto-loads .iwd files from this directory.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [ "${INSTALL_BOTWARFARE:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    echo "[install] INSTALL_BOTWARFARE=1 -> installing IW5 Bot Warfare v2.3.0..."
    curl -fsSL -L "https://github.com/ineedbots/iw5_bot_warfare/releases/download/v2.3.0/iw5bw230.zip" \
        -o /tmp/iw5bw.zip || echo "[install] WARN: BW zip download failed"
    if [ -f /tmp/iw5bw.zip ]; then
        rm -rf /tmp/iw5bw-extract
        unzip -q /tmp/iw5bw.zip -d /tmp/iw5bw-extract
        if [ -f /tmp/iw5bw-extract/z_svr_bots.iwd ]; then
            cp /tmp/iw5bw-extract/z_svr_bots.iwd "${STORAGE_DIR}/z_svr_bots.iwd"
            echo "[install] Bot Warfare IWD installed."
        else
            echo "[install] WARN: z_svr_bots.iwd missing from release archive."
        fi
    fi
else
    echo "[install] INSTALL_BOTWARFARE=0 -> skipping Bot Warfare install."
fi

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Write the runtime entrypoint.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat > "${SERVER_DIR}/entrypoint.sh" <<'__PLUTO_ENTRYPOINT__'
#!/bin/bash
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plutonium IW5 (MW3) server entrypoint for Pelican
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Env vars provided by the egg:
#   PLUTO_KEY         Server key from https://platform.plutonium.pw/serverkeys
#                     (must be an IW5MP key)
#   SERVER_PORT       UDP port Wings allocated (default 27016)
#   SERVER_NAME       Hostname injected into cfg sv_hostname
#   IW4M_IP           IW4MAdmin host IP. Empty = rcon wide open.
#   FS_GAME           mod folder under game/ (empty = vanilla)
#   AUTO_UPDATE       0 | 1 - refresh Plutonium bootstrap files on start
#   USE_XVFB          0 | 1 - wrap wine in xvfb-run
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

set -u

CONTAINER_DIR="/home/container"
PLUTO_DIR="${CONTAINER_DIR}/plutonium"
GAME_DIR="${CONTAINER_DIR}/game"
STORAGE_DIR="${PLUTO_DIR}/storage/iw5"
DEFAULTS_DIR="${PLUTO_DIR}/default-configs"

cd "${CONTAINER_DIR}" || exit 1

# --- sanity: bootstrap present ----------------------------------------------
if [ ! -f "${PLUTO_DIR}/bin/plutonium-bootstrapper-win32.exe" ]; then
    echo "[entrypoint] FATAL: Plutonium bootstrap not found at ${PLUTO_DIR}/bin/"
    echo "[entrypoint] Run the Reinstall action on this server from the Pelican panel."
    exit 1
fi

# --- optional: refresh Plutonium bootstrap files -----------------------------
if [ "${AUTO_UPDATE:-1}" = "1" ] && [ -x "${PLUTO_DIR}/plutonium-updater" ]; then
    echo "[entrypoint] Checking for Plutonium bootstrap updates..."
    ( cd "${PLUTO_DIR}" && ./plutonium-updater -d . -q --no-color ) \
        || echo "[entrypoint] WARN: updater failed; continuing with existing files."
fi

# --- sanity: game files uploaded --------------------------------------------
# IW5 sentinel: iw5mp.exe (the binary the bootstrapper launches). binkw32.dll
# is also present but not unique to MW3.
if [ ! -f "${GAME_DIR}/iw5mp.exe" ] || [ ! -f "${GAME_DIR}/main/iw_00.iwd" ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "[entrypoint] ============================================================"
    echo "[entrypoint]  MW3 GAME FILES NOT FOUND"
    echo "[entrypoint] ============================================================"
    echo "[entrypoint]  Upload your legally-owned Modern Warfare 3 files to:"
    echo "[entrypoint]    ${GAME_DIR}/"
    echo ""
    echo "[entrypoint]  Required entries (minimum):"
    echo "[entrypoint]    iw5mp.exe, binkw32.dll, localization.txt"
    echo "[entrypoint]    main/iw_*.iwd, main/0.dm"
    echo "[entrypoint]    miles/*.dll, zone/english/*.ff"
    echo ""
    echo "[entrypoint]  Source: free Steam app 42750 (CoD:MW3 Dedicated Server)"
    echo "[entrypoint]  Install in English; delete steam_api.dll after."
    echo "[entrypoint] ============================================================"
    exit 1
fi

# --- sanity: server key set --------------------------------------------------
if [ -z "${PLUTO_KEY:-}" ] || [ "${PLUTO_KEY}" = "CHANGE_ME" ] || [ "${PLUTO_KEY}" = "changeme" ]; then
    echo "[entrypoint] FATAL: PLUTO_KEY variable is not set."
    echo "[entrypoint] Generate one at https://platform.plutonium.pw/serverkeys"
    echo "[entrypoint] Pick game = IW5MP."
    exit 1
fi

# --- seed admin/ from defaults (first boot only) -----------------------------
# IW5 reads the server cfg from <gamepath>/admin/server.cfg, NOT from
# storage/iw5/. We seed admin/ on first boot once the user has uploaded their
# game files (so the game/ dir exists and is writable).
TARGET_CFG="${GAME_DIR}/admin/server.cfg"
TEMPLATE_CFG="${DEFAULTS_DIR}/admin/server.cfg.template"

if [ ! -f "${TARGET_CFG}" ]; then
    if [ ! -f "${TEMPLATE_CFG}" ]; then
        echo "[entrypoint] FATAL: no template at ${TEMPLATE_CFG}"
        echo "[entrypoint]        Did install complete? Run Reinstall."
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "[entrypoint] Seeding admin/ from defaults (first boot)"
    mkdir -p "${GAME_DIR}/admin"

    # Copy the DSR recipes and DSPL playlist verbatim
    cp "${DEFAULTS_DIR}/admin/default.dspl"   "${GAME_DIR}/admin/" 2>/dev/null || true
    cp "${DEFAULTS_DIR}/admin/"*_default.dsr  "${GAME_DIR}/admin/" 2>/dev/null || true

    # Transform server.cfg:
    #   1. Inject `set sv_hostname` (not in stock IW5 cfg; appended for IW4M title)
    #   2. Strip all existing rconWhitelistAdd lines (xerxes ships 4 example IPs)
    #   3. Re-add 127.0.0.1 plus IW4M_IP if provided, after rcon_rate_limit
    python3 - "${TEMPLATE_CFG}" "${TARGET_CFG}" "${SERVER_NAME:-Plutonium IW5 Server}" "${IW4M_IP:-}" <<'__PYEOF__'
import sys, re
src, dst, hostname, iw4m_ip = sys.argv[1:5]

with open(src, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

# Strip existing rconWhitelistAdd lines
lines = [ln for ln in lines if not re.match(r'\s*rconWhitelistAdd\b', ln)]

# Inject sv_hostname. The stock IW5 cfg comments "Server Name is set with your
# server key" but doesn't actually set it — we add a line so IW4MAdmin and the
# console window show a useful name.
hostname_escaped = hostname.replace('"', '\\"')
hostname_line = (
    f'set sv_hostname "{hostname_escaped}"               '
    f'// Console window / IW4MAdmin title. Real in-browser hostname comes from the platform key.\n'
)

# Insert hostname above the "set sv_motd" line (always present near top).
out = []
inserted_hostname = False
for ln in lines:
    if not inserted_hostname and re.match(r'\s*set\s+sv_motd\b', ln):
        out.append(hostname_line)
        inserted_hostname = True
    out.append(ln)
if not inserted_hostname:
    out.insert(0, hostname_line)

# Build whitelist block, splice in after rcon_rate_limit (last rcon_* set line
# in the xerxes IW5 cfg; same convention as T6).
whitelist_block = ['rconWhitelistAdd "127.0.0.1"                       '
                   '// Loopback is always whitelisted.\n']
if iw4m_ip.strip():
    whitelist_block.append(
        f'rconWhitelistAdd "{iw4m_ip.strip()}"                       '
        f'// IW4MAdmin host (set via IW4M_IP env var).\n'
    )

final = []
inserted_wl = False
for ln in out:
    final.append(ln)
    if not inserted_wl and re.match(r'\s*set\s+rcon_rate_limit\b', ln):
        final.extend(whitelist_block)
        inserted_wl = True

if not inserted_wl:
    final.append('\n')
    final.extend(whitelist_block)

with open(dst, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.writelines(final)

print(f"[entrypoint]   hostname      : {hostname}")
print(f"[entrypoint]   IW4M whitelist: {iw4m_ip if iw4m_ip.strip() else '<none>'}")
__PYEOF__

    if [ ! -f "${TARGET_CFG}" ]; then
        echo "[entrypoint] FATAL: template transform failed; ${TARGET_CFG} not written."
        exit 1
    fi
fi

# --- launch ------------------------------------------------------------------
cd "${PLUTO_DIR}" || exit 1

echo "[entrypoint] Starting Plutonium IW5 (Modern Warfare 3) dedicated server"
echo "[entrypoint]   port    : ${SERVER_PORT}"
echo "[entrypoint]   game    : ${GAME_DIR}"
echo "[entrypoint]   cfg     : game/admin/server.cfg"
echo "[entrypoint]   fs_game : ${FS_GAME:-<none>}"

# IW5 uses +set sv_config (NOT +exec) and +start_map_rotate (NOT +map_rotate).
# Confirmed against xerxes-at/IW5ServerConfig/!start_mp_server.bat.
WINE_CMD=( wine bin/plutonium-bootstrapper-win32.exe
    iw5mp
    "${GAME_DIR}"
    -dedicated
    +set key       "${PLUTO_KEY}"
    +set net_port  "${SERVER_PORT}"
    +set sv_config "server.cfg"
    +start_map_rotate )

# Conditionally insert +set fs_game only if non-empty.
if [ -n "${FS_GAME:-}" ]; then
    WINE_CMD=( "${WINE_CMD[@]:0:8}" +set fs_game "${FS_GAME}" "${WINE_CMD[@]:8}" )
fi

if [ "${USE_XVFB:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    exec xvfb-run --auto-servernum "${WINE_CMD[@]}"
else
    exec "${WINE_CMD[@]}"
fi
__PLUTO_ENTRYPOINT__
chmod +x "${SERVER_DIR}/entrypoint.sh"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# README breadcrumb
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat > "${SERVER_DIR}/READ_ME_FIRST.txt" <<'__PLUTO_README__'
Plutonium IW5 (Modern Warfare 3) server - next steps
====================================================

1. Upload your LEGALLY-OWNED Modern Warfare 3 game files to:
     /home/container/game/

   Source: Steam app 42750 (free "CoD: MW3 - Dedicated Server" download).
   Must install in English; delete steam_api.dll after install.

   Required entries (minimum):
     iw5mp.exe, binkw32.dll, localization.txt
     main/iw_*.iwd, main/0.dm
     miles/*.dll, zone/english/*.ff

2. Generate a server key at https://platform.plutonium.pw/serverkeys
   - Pick game = IW5MP.
   - Pick a hostname. THIS is what shows in the in-browser server list.
     The cfg sv_hostname is just for the console window/IW4MAdmin title.
   - Set the key as PLUTO_KEY on the Startup tab.

3. Set SERVER_NAME (for IW4M/window title) and IW4M_IP (optional) on
   Startup tab.

4. Start the server. On first boot, admin/ is seeded inside game/:
     /home/container/game/admin/server.cfg
     /home/container/game/admin/*.dsr  (gametype recipes)
     /home/container/game/admin/default.dspl

   Edit server.cfg to set rcon_password (required for IW4MAdmin) and
   tweak sv_maprotation (uses 'dsr <recipe> map <mapname>' tokens).

5. IW4MAdmin server entry block:
     {
       "IPAddress": "127.0.0.1",
       "Port": <SERVER_PORT>,
       "Password": "<rcon_password from server.cfg>",
       "ManualLogPath": "/home/container/.wine/drive_c/users/container/AppData/Local/Plutonium/storage/iw5/games_mp.log",
       "RConParserVersion": "Plutonium IW5 Parser",
       "EventParserVersion": "Plutonium IW5 Parser",
       "ReservedSlotNumber": 0
     }

   ManualLogPath is mandatory under Wine (short-path issue).

"Heartbeat successful" in the log = live and registered.
__PLUTO_README__

echo "[install] ============================================================"
echo "[install]  IW5 install complete."
echo "[install]  xerxes-at admin/ staged at plutonium/default-configs/admin/."
echo "[install]  Will be copied to game/admin/ on first boot."
echo "[install]  Upload MW3 game files to /home/container/game/ then start."
echo "[install] ============================================================"

variables.name: Plutonium Server Key
variables.description: Server key from https://platform.plutonium.pw/serverkeys. Pick the matching game variant when generating (IW5MP). The hostname registered on the platform is the REAL in-browser hostname; the cfg sv_hostname only sets the IW4MAdmin/console title.

variables.name: Server Name (cfg sv_hostname)
variables.description: Hostname injected into sv_hostname in the cfg. Supports ^1-^9 color codes. Note: in-browser hostname comes from the platform server key, not this value.

variables.name: IW4MAdmin Host IP
variables.description: IP address of the IW4MAdmin host. Added to rconWhitelistAdd along with 127.0.0.1. Leave empty if IW4MAdmin runs on the same host or if you don't use IW4MAdmin.

variables.name: Install Mapvote
variables.description: INSTALL-TIME ONLY. When set to 1, downloads Resxt's IW5 mapvote.gsc into plutonium/storage/iw5/scripts/ during install. Reinstall the server to toggle after first install.

variables.name: Install Bot Warfare
variables.description: INSTALL-TIME ONLY. When set to 1, downloads ineedbots/iw5_bot_warfare v2.3.0 (z_svr_bots.iwd) into plutonium/storage/iw5/. Reinstall to toggle.

variables.name: Auto-Update Plutonium
variables.description: Run plutonium-updater on every server start to refresh bootstrap files. 1 = enabled (recommended), 0 = disabled.

variables.name: fs_game (mod path)
variables.description: Mod folder relative to the game dir, e.g. 'mods/mymod'. Leave empty for vanilla. Passed as +set fs_game only if non-empty.

variables.name: Use Xvfb
variables.description: Wrap Wine in xvfb-run. Leave at 0 unless the server fails with display/X11 errors (dedicated normally doesn't need it).

variables.name: Wine Debug
variables.description: WINEDEBUG value. Default suppresses all Wine chatter. Set to 'fixme-all' to debug Wine issues.
